Pipe area A = pi D^2 / 4 = pi (0.10)^2 / 4 = 0.007854 m2.
Velocity V = Q / A = 0.025 / 0.007854 = 3.183 m/s.
(a) Re = rho V D / mu = 998 x 3.183 x 0.10 / 0.001 = 317700.
(b) epsilon / D = 0.046 mm / 100 mm = 0.00046.
Colebrook: 1/sqrt(f) = -2 log10[(epsilon/D)/3.7 + 2.51/(Re sqrt(f))].
Iteration gives 1/sqrt(f) = 7.47 and f = 0.0179.
(c) Velocity head V^2/(2g) = 3.183^2/(2 x 9.81) = 0.516 m.
Loss coefficient: f L/D + sum K = 0.0179 x 150/0.10 + 5.5 = 32.35.
Friction and minor loss = 32.35 x 0.516 = 16.70 m.
Pump head H = 12 + 16.70 = 28.70 m.
(d) Hydraulic power = rho g Q H = 998 x 9.81 x 0.025 x 28.70 = 7026 W.
Shaft power = 7026 / 0.72 = 9758 W = 9.76 kW.
FINAL (a): 317700 dimensionless
FINAL (b): 0.0179 dimensionless
FINAL (c): 28.70 m
FINAL (d): 9.76 kW
